original.guitar: Paisley-finish Telecaster (Crook Custom and Fender), Tele bridge pickup
original.amp: Dr. Z Z-Wreck (Trainwreck-style, EL84) and Z-Verb heads, plus Vox AC30 and Fender Deluxe Reverb
original.notes: Built from his documented live rig. His exact knob settings are not published.

recipes.tips: Channel A is the Vox/Dr. Z flavour: clean with a little hair on hard picking. Channel B is a cleaner, sparkly blackface sound. Hybrid-pick (pick plus middle and ring fingers) and mute with the picking hand to get the snap. Songs: the rhythm and fills of Mud on the Tires, Ticks, Water.
recipes.why: Paisley's clean sound is a Tele bridge pickup into an EL84 amp that's just breaking up, lightly compressed, with a short slapback. The AC15TB is the closest EL84 model on the Tonelab.

sources.title: Premier Guitar: Rig Rundown, Brad Paisley's amps and effects

original.amp: Dr. Z Z-Wreck pushed by an overdrive (TS-808 / Wampler Paisley Drive)
original.effects: Overdrive, analog-style delay (Aqua Puss), spring reverb
original.notes: Built from his documented live rig. His exact knob settings are not published.

recipes.tips: Channel A for fast country-rock licks, channel B for the big solos. Turn the Tube OD off for a cleaner, snappier lead. Roll the guitar volume back to 7 and the sound cleans up for fills. Songs: the solos in Mud on the Tires, Ticks, Alcohol, Online.
recipes.why: His solo sound is a Tube Screamer-style overdrive with low drive and high level, pushing an EL84 amp into breakup. The AC30TB stands in for the Z-Wreck, and the analog delay sits just behind the notes.

sources.title: Premier Guitar: Rig Rundown, Brad Paisley's amps and effects
